problem: If $U={t,u,v,w,x,y}$ is the universal set and $S={w,x,y},$ then the complement of $S$ is
worked_solution:
The complement of $S,$ denoted $\overset{―}{S},$ consists of every element in the universal set $U$ that is not in the set $S.$

The only elements of $U$ that are not in $S$ are $t,$ $u,$ and $v.$

Therefore, the complement of $S$ is

$$
\overset{―}{S}={t,u,v}.
$$
